paragraphs: Rav Adda bar Ahava: Berakhot 20a. Rav Acha bar Ahava: Eruvin 98a. Rabbi Ami bar Ahava: Yevamot 29b.[^1]

notes.text: The selected Davidson Berakhot 20a paragraph names Rav Adda bar Ahava, Eruvin 98a names Rav Acha bar Ahava, and Yevamot 29b names Rabbi Ammi with bar Ahava in parentheses. These support the local titles and three separate patronymic pointers; the supplied Ami spelling remains. The notice does not establish a shared father or an identity between these bearers. Historical notes remain in the immutable versions.
